records.title: HyperFrames
records.summary: An HTML and GSAP video renderer with a skill pack. The agent writes a page, the CLI captures it frame by frame and encodes MP4.
records.why_it_matters: One of the two renderers most agent-made video runs on, and its skill carries numeric motion, review and loudness rules.
records.fit_notes: Start here for a fully local render with no licence fee. The skill asks the agent to send a usage beacon through the CLI at start; read the skill before installing if that matters to you. Hosted media features need a HeyGen sign-in.

claims.text: Its motion reference tells the agent not to reuse one ease and duration for every element.
claims.quote: The same `power2.out` at 0.5 s on everything is the flat default that makes a film feel generated.

claims.text: It sets exits shorter than entrances by a stated ratio.

checked.what: independent fact-check: claims, prose and category fields against the saved source

records.title: Remotion Agent Skills
records.summary: The official skill set for writing Remotion (React) video with a coding agent: creation, markup, captions, rendering.
records.why_it_matters: The reference skills for the other dominant renderer. They state support for Codex and Cursor as well as Claude Code.
records.fit_notes: The skills repo has no licence file, and Remotion itself has a company licence: check both before client work. The skill opens a preview for a person; it does not make the agent inspect frames.

claims.text: Its layout rule keeps key text inside a stated safe area.
claims.quote: For 1080px-wide videos, keep key text at least 80px from the sides and 100px from the top and bottom.

claims.text: It asks for one focal point per scene.
claims.quote: Decide what the viewer should notice first in each scene. Build the frame around that one thing.

checked.what: independent fact-check: claims, prose and category fields against the saved source

records.title: video-use
records.summary: A skill for cutting raw footage into a finished video by conversation, with hard audio and cut rules and a self-evaluation pass on the rendered file.
records.why_it_matters: The clearest example of a skill that inspects its own output at every cut before handing it over.
records.fit_notes: Transcription uses a paid ElevenLabs key, so it is not a free local path as shipped. Its SKILL.md tells the agent, if the key is missing, to ask you to paste one and write it to .env; set it in the environment yourself.

claims.text: It forbids cutting inside a word and snaps cuts to transcript word boundaries.
claims.quote: **Never cut inside a word.** Snap every cut edge to a word boundary from the Scribe transcript.

checked.what: independent fact-check: claims, prose and category fields against the saved source

records.title: claude-code-video-toolkit
records.summary: A Claude Code workspace of skills, slash commands and Python tools for script to voiceover to visuals to MP4. Its video-design skill fixes type, alignment and colour rules.
records.why_it_matters: Its design rules address the most common amateur tells: wrapped titles, drifting alignment, colour changes with no reason.
records.fit_notes: Claude Code only as stated. The quick start needs no API keys; its AI tools run on your own cloud GPU account.

claims.text: Its design skill bounds the review loop at three rounds.

records.title: claude-remotion-skill
records.summary: A Remotion motion-graphics skill with non-negotiable easing, stagger and exit rules and a mandatory render, extract frames, inspect, fix loop.
records.why_it_matters: Adds the frame-inspection step the official Remotion skills leave to a person.
records.fit_notes: Two of its rules (idle elements breathe; never a flat background) contradict the HyperFrames and video-design skills. Pick one rule set per project.

claims.text: It bans linear interpolation in every composition.

checked.what: independent fact-check: claims, prose and category fields against the saved source

records.title: video-shotcraft
records.summary: A product-promo skill built on shot-recipe cards and real page captures, written in Chinese.
records.why_it_matters: It makes the reviewer a different agent from the maker, which is the strongest review-loop rule found so far.
records.fit_notes: The repo is four months old with a high star count; treat popularity as unconfirmed. Needs network for Freesound sound search; page capture can run against a local dev server. Instructions are in Chinese.

claims.text: Before delivery it requires an independent final review by a sub-agent with a clean context.
claims.quote: 交付前必须派一个干净上下文的 subagent 做独立终检
